methodology: Covering array over 10 orthogonal stack dimensions (~2e9 full product). Each value of every dimension is exercised at least once (each-choice/1-wise), deterministically (round-robin by index, no RNG, reproducible on every host). Per cell: codec round-trip (per protocol), AES-GCM seal (per suite), transport relay (from the maximized-routes ledger), composed end-to-end. Cross-arch/lang/platform cells are bound here and dispatchable to their target via conformance_grid/lang_conformance.
